overall_notes: Paper focuses primarily on inference speed optimization rather than traditional NLG quality evaluation. The metrics used (speedup, acceptance rate, FLOPs) are computational efficiency metrics rather than linguistic quality metrics like BLEU/ROUGE. The answer for Q2 was changed from 'No' to 'Yes' because these computational metrics ARE used to automatically evaluate the generated outputs, even though they focus on efficiency rather than quality.
